oud.title: Natural oud
oud.text: Oud — the resin-rich heartwood of the agar tree — has perfumed the homes of the Gulf for generations. The same depth that gives <product>OUD</product> its character can fill your majlis: hand-selected chips, rising slowly from the mabkhara.
